description: This PHP file defines the EmailProcessor entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping it to the database table 'ohrm_email_processor' using Doctrine ORM. It includes properties for id, email (relation), and className, along with their respective getters and setters.

classes.name: EmailProcessor
classes.description: Entity class representing the email processor configuration, including database mapping annotations and properties for id, email, and className.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the email processor entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the email processor entity.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Retrieves the class name associated with this email processor, if any.

methods.name: setClassName
methods.description: Sets the class name associated with this email processor.
